note: Final audit fixes for MLB (offfield roster_moves exclusion, player_participation detach, awards electorates/reliever, hits scorer/starter-change, first-inning and counting-text residue). Sorts after the other MLB patches.

attach.why: Timestamped league, venue and schedule-leak reports about whether the 2027 special-event game is staged and which clubs are named; reports precede the official announcement, so a report's timestamp relative to market close and its source matter (player and team-strength news is irrelevant to this contract).

Price reaction to schedule leaks and announcements: the traded price aggregates participants' information about staging and the pairing, so large moves ahead of the official release signal leaked information; read it with mlb.news_source_reliability_score.

blueprint_exclusions.reason: Base rate x roster-transaction calendar interaction inherited from the off_field blueprint; mlb.roster_moves was audited IRRELEVANT here (transactions change who plays, not whether the league stages a special-event game or which two clubs it picks), so the interaction is excluded. Time-conditioning of the base rate comes from mlb.special_event_game_staging and the labour-regime x lifecycle interaction.

attach.why: Reliever of the Year (KXMLBALRELOTY/KXMLBNLRELOTY) is a reliever-only electorate decision; this gives the candidate pool its saves, leverage and WPA features, which award_stats_war (generic WAR/counting) does not.

BBWAA-class ballot history only (MVP, Cy Young, Rookie, Manager of the Year): points scales, ballot timing and finalist announcement; other electorates are in award_electorate_procedure and award-specific inputs.

KXMLBHIT/KXMLBTB settle on the official scorer's hit-versus-error call, so a park's hit/error shift adds or removes a hit and its total bases at the borderline xBA bucket; this archetype's officiating_rules coverage relies on it.

KXMLBHIT/KXMLBTB/KXMLBHRR stay live when the opposing starter is scratched or swapped (only the named hitter's scratch or no-PA voids), so the per-PA hit and total-base rates for sp_quality must be a mixture over announced and replacement starters.

Rules for called games (Fair Price if the inning is not completed), the 9th-inning no-bottom-half wording and the RFI one-line rule; the inning strikes listed run innings 1-9, so no extra-innings clause is relevant.
